chapter.title: Chapter Fourteen: Everybody Has a Buyer
chapter.subtitle: Every solution has a logo and a catch.
chapter.description: Competing rescue plans split the coalition until their hidden costs are read aloud.

tips: Listen for the terms before the first contest.

scenes.speaker: Techbro Rich
scenes.text: Good news. I have partners: luxury fitness, branded worship, and a content jail.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Contraband
scenes.text: Content jail is just a studio with worse snacks. I consulted.

scenes.speaker: Church Auntie
scenes.text: Branded worship is a phrase that should fear lightning.

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: My buyer keeps public events quarterly.

scenes.speaker: Bottle Girl
scenes.text: Quarterly means four cookouts and three hundred sixty-one locked days.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: I have a community cooperative proposal.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: It currently says CHAIRMAN BLUE in letters larger than the budget.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: I can reduce the font and the ego attached.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Read every plan's access terms. Which days can we actually get in? Read that part before you clap.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

preDialogue.speaker: Promoter
preDialogue.text: Winner gets ten uninterrupted minutes before the owner.

preDialogue.speaker: Bottle Girl
preDialogue.text: Ten minutes. I’ll hold the microphone and the stopwatch. Try me.

preDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
preDialogue.text: My deck has synergies and a capitalization table.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: My table capitalizes random Words too.

preDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
preDialogue.text: I brought two alternate buyers. Competitive tension is healthy.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: Healthy for who? Read the access terms out loud before anybody smile.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: If the terms lock the community out after dark, we not interested in the smile.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I’m scoring each pitch on access, noise, and whether they try to rename the milk crate.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: Rename nothing. Especially not the schedule around my child.

postDialogue.speaker: Promoter
postDialogue.text: Ten minutes are yours. My quarterly plan remains on the table.

postDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
postDialogue.text: Four days a year? Even my worst ex showed up more than that.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: I confiscated Rich's laser pointer after it challenged the moon.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
postDialogue.text: Both pitches fail the after-dark test. We keep looking.

postDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
postDialogue.text: You’re leaving money on the table.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: We leaving the community on the roof. Different math.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Math logged. Milk crate remains undefeated and unnamed.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: Winner rewrites the governance page.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: The community already rewrote it. You are competing for who presents.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: Right. Old reflex.

preDialogue.speaker: OG Uncle
preDialogue.text: You caught yourself. Don’t celebrate yet; you still made a chairman banner.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: Co-op chair is rotating. I can sit in it and also leave it.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: He practiced that sentence till the mirror filed minutes.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: Center lane close while the childcare group cross downstairs. Schedule bend around people.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: Schedule bends around people now. Not the other way around.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I’m notarizing that sentence. Growth exhibit A.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: You present. The board has rotating seats and no permanent chairman.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: Also childcare reimbursement, because meetings do not raise children.

postDialogue.speaker: Cracked Head
postDialogue.text: Put me on setup, not leadership. I need a record of ordinary work.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: You host first. I set chairs and don’t stack them into government.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: Two chairs maximum per hand, Mr. Growth.

postDialogue.speaker: OG Uncle
postDialogue.text: Let him carry four. Accountability can build forearms.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Forearms and humility. Package deal.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

phases.name: Public Pressure
phases.description: At round three, the opponent gains 1 Motion.

phases.name: Late Arrival
phases.description: At round 6, the opponent draws one card from its remaining ten-card deck. If the deck is empty, no card is added.

passive.name: Announced Terms
passive.description: The final table escalates once without changing the agreement outside the match.

preDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
preDialogue.text: Win and I disclose my option deadline. Lose and you stop calling my plan displacement on my own livestream.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: No. The match can settle disclosure because you offered it. Speech is not your wager to own.

preDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
preDialogue.text: Fine. Deadline disclosure only.

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: Recorded with all the boring parts intact.

preDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
preDialogue.text: Last option: I match your deposit if the co-op take my branding on the stairwell.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: Stairwell stay blank. Branding is how the roof got in trouble.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: We already raised the deposit. Your option is late and loud.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Late, loud, and trying to put a logo on the stairs. That’s a no from the archive.

preDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
preDialogue.text: You’re making this harder than it needs to be.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: Hard is how we keep it. Easy is how we lose it.

postDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
postDialogue.text: My reservation expires premiere night at ten. It is non-exclusive: the owner can accept a compliant competing offer before then.

postDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
postDialogue.text: Ten o’clock. Finally, a number we can use.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
postDialogue.text: And now it is dated, witnessed, and useful.

postDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
postDialogue.text: Option declined. I’ll be at the premiere anyway.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
postDialogue.text: Premiere is public. Your seat is not a share of the lease.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Seat logged. Share denied. Archive ruthless tonight.

tips: The match result and the real-world agreement remain separate.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: The cooperative cannot match Rich's price today.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: But it can guarantee public hours, repair funding, and resident oversight.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: I know people from the cellblock who built programs out of less than this.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Contraband
scenes.text: Then I can admire folding tables from a respectful distance.

scenes.speaker: OG Uncle
scenes.text: The owner needs evidence the block can perform the agreement, not just desire it.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: Premiere night demonstrates operations. Agreements from partner venues demonstrate continuity.

scenes.speaker: Church Auntie
scenes.text: Then feed the partners before anybody calls it networking.
